title: Use a single attached product image as the ONLY reference and explicitly…
content:
Use a single attached product image as the ONLY reference and explicitly instruct Seedance to preserve exact pack/logo/typography/colors/proportions/materials; add “Never redesign packaging or invent text” to prevent drift.

For consistent 30s ads, provide a timecoded shot list (e.g., 00:00–00:03, 00:03–00:07, etc.) describing action, environment changes, and intended match-cuts for each segment.

Specify camera language directly (macro tracking, low racing angles, sweeping cranes, fast orbits, whip pans, push-throughs, scale shifts) and add constraints like “keep geography readable, shapes stable, motion smooth.”

Define transition rules (matching spin, color wipes, occlusion, spirals, splashes/impacts) and explicitly forbid “random warping or arbitrary cuts” to maintain continuity.

If generating with native audio, list the exact sound palette (percussion, boings, clicks, impacts, splashes, pops), instruct “sync color changes to the beat,” and specify “no dialogue” plus a precise end beat (finish with a bounce).

Add a quality/negative checklist to the prompt (readable logo, consistent scale, glossy materials, rich lighting; no extra brands, invented words, deformed packs, dull colors, flat lighting, humans, clutter).

ja.content:
単一の添付商品画像を唯一の参照として使用し、Seedance に対してパック／ロゴ／タイポグラフィ／色／比率／素材を正確に保持するよう明示的に指示してください。ドリフトを防ぐために「パッケージを再デザインしない、テキストを勝手に作らない」を追加します。

一貫した30秒広告にするには、タイムコード付きのショットリスト（例：00:00–00:03、00:03–00:07 など）を用意し、各セグメントごとのアクション、環境変化、意図するマッチカットを記述します。

カメラ言語は直接指定し（macro tracking、low racing angles、sweeping cranes、fast orbits、whip pans、push-throughs、scale shifts）、さらに「地理関係を読みやすく保つ、形状を安定させる、動きを滑らかにする」といった制約を加えます。

トランジションのルールを定義し（matching spin、color wipes、occlusion、spirals、splashes/impacts）、連続性を保つために「random warping や arbitrary cuts」を明確に禁止します。

ネイティブ音声で生成する場合は、正確なサウンドパレット（percussion、boings、clicks、impacts、splashes、pops）を列挙し、「色の変化をビートに同期させる」と指示し、「no dialogue」に加えて明確な終わりのビート（finish with a bounce）を指定します。

プロンプトには品質／ネガティブのチェックリストも追加します（readable logo、consistent scale、glossy materials、rich lighting；extra brands、invented words、deformed packs、dull colors、flat lighting、humans、clutter はなし）。

ko.content:
단일로 첨부된 제품 이미지를 유일한 참고 자료로 사용하고, Seedance가 정확한 패키지/로고/타이포그래피/색상/비율/재질을 그대로 유지하도록 명시적으로 지시하세요. 드리프트를 방지하기 위해 “Never redesign packaging or invent text”를 추가하세요.

일관된 30초 광고를 위해, 각 구간의 액션, 환경 변화, 의도된 매치 컷을 설명하는 타임코드 샷 리스트(예: 00:00–00:03, 00:03–00:07 등)를 제공하세요.

카메라 언어를 직접 지정하세요(macro tracking, low racing angles, sweeping cranes, fast orbits, whip pans, push-throughs, scale shifts) 그리고 “keep geography readable, shapes stable, motion smooth” 같은 제약을 추가하세요.

전환 규칙을 정의하세요(matching spin, color wipes, occlusion, spirals, splashes/impacts) 그리고 연속성을 유지하기 위해 “random warping or arbitrary cuts”를 명시적으로 금지하세요.

네이티브 오디오로 생성하는 경우, 정확한 사운드 팔레트(percussion, boings, clicks, impacts, splashes, pops)를 나열하고, “sync color changes to the beat”를 지시하며, “no dialogue”와 정확한 엔드 비트(끝은 bounce로 마무리)를 지정하세요.

프롬프트에 품질/네거티브 체크리스트를 추가하세요(읽기 쉬운 로고, 일관된 스케일, 광택 있는 재질, 풍부한 조명; 추가 브랜드 없음, 만들어낸 단어 없음, 변형된 패키지 없음, 칙칙한 색감 없음, 평면적인 조명 없음, 사람 없음, 잡동사니 없음).

pt.content:
Use uma única imagem do produto anexada como a ÚNICA referência e instrua explicitamente o Seedance a preservar exatamente embalagem/logo/tipografia/cores/proporções/materiais; adicione “Never redesign packaging or invent text” para evitar desvios.

Para anúncios consistentes de 30s, forneça uma lista de planos com timecode (por exemplo, 00:00–00:03, 00:03–00:07 etc.) descrevendo ação, mudanças no ambiente e os match-cuts pretendidos para cada segmento.

Especifique diretamente a linguagem de câmera (macro tracking, low racing angles, sweeping cranes, fast orbits, whip pans, push-throughs, scale shifts) e adicione restrições como “keep geography readable, shapes stable, motion smooth.”

Defina regras de transição (matching spin, color wipes, occlusion, spirals, splashes/impacts) e proíba explicitamente “random warping or arbitrary cuts” para manter a continuidade.

Se estiver gerando com áudio nativo, liste a paleta sonora exata (percussion, boings, clicks, impacts, splashes, pops), instrua “sync color changes to the beat,” e especifique “no dialogue” além de uma batida final precisa (finish with a bounce).

Adicione uma checklist de qualidade/negativos ao prompt (readable logo, consistent scale, glossy materials, rich lighting; no extra brands, invented words, deformed packs, dull colors, flat lighting, humans, clutter).

--- TWEET CITADO ---
Planos de trinta segundos com áudio nativo.

Até cinquenta referências — seus personagens, seu mundo, seus sons, suas direções — tudo mantido consistente em cada frame.

使用一张附带的产品图片作为**唯一**参考，并明确指示 Seedance 保持包装/Logo/字体/颜色/比例/材质完全一致；加入“Never redesign packaging or invent text”，以防止偏移。

对于一致的 30 秒广告，请提供带时间码的分镜列表（例如 00:00–00:03、00:03–00:07 等），描述每个片段的动作、环境变化以及预期的 match-cut。

直接指定镜头语言（macro tracking、low racing angles、sweeping cranes、fast orbits、whip pans、push-throughs、scale shifts），并加入诸如“keep geography readable, shapes stable, motion smooth”之类的约束。

在提示词中加入质量/负面检查清单（readable logo、consistent scale、glossy materials、rich lighting；no extra brands、invented words、deformed packs、dull colors、flat lighting、humans、clutter）。
